description: Check a site's browser/OS chrome and PWA metadata: every <link rel=icon> favicon plus /favicon.ico, apple-touch-icon(s), and the web app manifest (fetched and parsed: name, short_name, start_url, display, theme_color, background_color, icons with sizes/purpose), each with its HTTP status, plus the theme-color meta tag. Flags broken icon links and missing 192/512 manifest icons. Deterministic HTML/JSON parsing, no AI. For a whole-page SEO audit (which includes a lighter version of this) use seo_audit.

url.description: Page to check, usually the homepage, e.g. https://example.com

name: favicon_manifest_check
